telemetry_name: Formula Ultimate Hybrid Gen3 - High Downforce
confidence_notes: Exact current-game identity and all user-facing controls were directly verified.
scope_notes: Reviewed guided observation for Formula Ultimate Hybrid Gen3 - High Downforce. Formula Ultimate Gen2 was this car's pre-rename name and is now recorded as a retired identity rather than carried here, because the certified build no longer reports it and the string is one digit away from the separate Formula Ultimate Hybrid Gen2 car.

additional_telemetry_names.basis: Base configuration of the same car, observed exactly in live telemetry. AMS2 selects the aero configuration from the circuit, so a driver reaches this identity without choosing it. Controls are inherited from the driven high-downforce configuration and were not separately tested.
